_comment: Asset Store catalog. Each pack's content lives under packs/<id>/ mirroring INSTALL-RELATIVE paths (e.g. packs/tac/Mods/Tac/scripts.vol installs to <game>/Mods/Tac/scripts.vol). tools/publish-store.ps1 in the native repo validates this file, hashes the content, regenerates store.json, and commits. Adding an asset never touches the game manifest or bumps the game version.

packs.title: Tribes Aerial Combat (TAC) 1.41
packs.description: Team Aerial Combat - teamwork-required flight combat by the TPG team (2001). Full client and server: 29 missions (CTF, C&H, TDM, D&D, F&R), custom skins and sounds, and the complete server-side scripts so you can host it. Launch with -mod Tac or use the toggle below.
packs.author: TAC Development Team

packs.title: Red Moon RPG (RMRPG)
packs.description: Red Moon RPG - the Tribes RPG variant that stacks on top of the base RPG mod: its own missions, skins, GUI and server scripts. Needed to join Red Moon servers. Launch with -mod rpg -mod rmrpg (RMRPG stacks on RPG) or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Red Moon RPG team

packs.title: Star Wars RPG (SWRPG)
packs.description: Star Wars Tribes RPG by Hazor and team - a self-contained RPG mod set in the Star Wars universe, built on the Star Wars TC 2.0 art and sounds: missions, skins, models and full server scripts. Needed to join SWRPG servers. Launch with -mod SWRPG or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Hazor / SWRPG team

packs.title: Star Wars TC 2.0
packs.description: Star Wars Total Conversion 2.0 for Tribes: Star Wars vehicles, weapons, models, sounds and missions. Needed to join Star Wars TC servers. Launch with -mod StarWars or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Star Wars TC team

packs.title: Tribes Annihilation
packs.description: Annihilation - the classic Tribes mod: new weapons, armors, vehicles, voices and objects, plus its missions, skins and complete server scripts so you can host it. Needed to join Annihilation servers. Launch with -mod Annihilation or use the toggle below.
packs.author: Annihilation team
